name: NX Recall
tagline: Local-first conversation recall — transcript, speaker identity, search. Nothing leaves the machine.

artifacts.label: Daemon + desktop app (Linux)
artifacts.postInstallNote: Two one-time steps in a terminal: `~/.local/bin/recalld models fetch` (~135 MB of speech models, the only network use in the program), then `systemctl --user daemon-reload && systemctl --user enable --now nx-recall`. Capture is default-deny — nothing is recorded until `recalld allow <program>`. Outside its own bin/ and lib/ this install writes exactly two files, share/systemd/user/nx-recall.service and share/applications/nx-recall.desktop, both removed on uninstall. Your transcripts and models in ~/.local/share/nx-recall are not: that directory outlives uninstall on purpose.
